fact: On 30 November 2021 Gustafsson states that SA-SAMS is used by around 90% of schools, by over 97% in six provinces, 94% in KwaZulu-Natal, 86% in Gauteng and 0% in Western Cape, and that daily attendance data quality is known only for Limpopo.
title: By how much has school participation declined as a result of the pandemic?
